name: Nasal dilator / strips

lead: Nasal strips and internal dilators are adhesive or insert devices that hold the nostrils open. They are used for congestion, sleep and snoring.
In looksmaxxing communities they are sometimes discussed in connection with jaw or face development; they affect airflow in the moment and are not reported to change facial structure.

paras: A spring-like strip across the nose lifts the nasal side walls and stiffens the nasal valve, lowering airflow resistance while worn.

Side effects are mostly adhesive skin irritation. A systematic review found no significant change in apnea-hypopnea index or snoring index in sleep apnea, so they are not a treatment for it. Benefits for congestion or snoring in people without apnea are mostly subjective.
